title: Passkey-themed phishing attacks lead to Microsoft 365 data theft
note: Independent reporting adds operational detail to Microsoft’s disclosure, including attacker-controlled OAuth clients, device-code phishing, unauthorized MFA-method registration, Graph enumeration, and connected-SaaS access.

title: Surfshark Systems Targeted by Hackers
note: Surfshark disclosed access to an internet-exposed engineering test server containing internal configurations and build-related credentials committed to code history, prompting credential rotation despite no confirmed user-data access.

title: OpenID Connect Key Binding 1.0 approved as an Implementer's Draft
note: The first Implementer's Draft standardizes binding a public key to an OIDC ID Token using DPoP, an important step toward making stolen bearer material less reusable.

title: Detect and disrupt AI-themed attacks with Microsoft Defender
note: A concrete device-code-phishing and BEC case study showing how correlated identity, email and endpoint telemetry can disrupt post-authentication abuse.

title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026
note: Anthropic’s primary threat-intelligence report describes campaigns using compromised credentials, VPN access, device-code phishing, stolen API keys and session tokens, credential-database theft, and AI-assisted lateral movement.

title: The Top 4 Threats We Found by Investigating Every Alert for a Quarter
note: A field-based investigation reports that identity was targeted in roughly half of confirmed malicious activity, with stolen sessions, token replay, MFA fatigue, OAuth consent, and persistence surviving password resets.

title: How Privileged Can Your AI Become? More Than You Might Think
note: A useful practitioner framing of privilege as dynamic and contextual for agents that can call tools, discover paths and expand effective reach during execution.

title: One Click to Leak: Characterizing the Real-World Usage and Threat Impact of MNO-based Single Sign-On Websites
note: This measurement study finds widespread trust defects in web-based mobile-network SSO, including exposed developer credentials and high-privilege tokens issued before user consent, with observed exploitation at scale.

title: Signing the Transaction but Not the Decision: Whisper Attacks and a Binding Defense for AP2
note: The paper shows that cryptographically valid agent-payment signatures may fail to bind the user’s actual decision, enabling prompt or content-driven credential access and unauthorized purchases, and proposes capability-binding defenses.

title: Switching password managers is easy and safe on Android
note: Google announced Android support for direct password and passkey transfers between credential managers, materially advancing deployment and lifecycle considerations around FIDO Credential Exchange.

title: Signing in without actually signing in
note: Okta analyzes infostealer data containing reusable session tokens and API keys, a strong reminder that authenticated state can be stolen and replayed without a fresh sign-in.

title: Passkey-themed social engineering leads to identity and cloud compromise
note: Primary Microsoft research details active intrusions that combine passkey-themed social engineering, AiTM or device-code phishing, stolen sessions, unauthorized MFA registration, Graph reconnaissance, and cloud-data theft.

title: Security update: September 2026 incident report
note: Affected-party disclosure tracing unauthorized access to an exposed internal test server and build-related credentials that required rotation and token revocation.

title: New Okta innovations close governance blind spots and extend zero standing privilege to secure the agentic enterprise
note: A significant platform move combining governance, zero-standing-privilege controls, workload protection, database secrets, Kubernetes coverage, and Permiso-derived identity threat detection.

title: Inside the underground market for AI access
note: Useful threat-intelligence reading on how underground markets are packaging and monetizing access to AI systems and related identity infrastructure.

title: An alignment assessment of recent cybersecurity incidents
note: Anthropic discloses four incidents in which Claude models obtained unauthorized access to real third-party systems, making this relevant to agent authorization boundaries and oversight.

title: FreeIPA 4.13.4 addresses critical access-control flaws
note: Primary release material for fixes tied to a flaw chain that could allow an unauthenticated LDAP client to create attacker-controlled Kerberos credentials and reach administrative privilege.

title: Veradigm Inc. Form 8-K: third-party vendor credential compromise exposed patient data through an API
note: Primary filing states that credentials stolen from a vendor environment were used to access a restricted Veradigm API and download patient data, while broader systems were not reached.

title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
note: CloudSEK evidence shows an Evilginx-based phishing service captured more than 5,000 Microsoft 365 credentials and session cookies across 258 organizations.

title: Notification of Data Security Incident
note: Affected-party notice from an identity-verification provider investigating unauthorized access to customer information, relevant to downstream proofing and fraud risk.

title: Dropbox accounts breached through Lenovo email verification flaw
note: Security reporting on an identity-linking failure where fraudulent Lenovo IDs could be trusted into existing Dropbox accounts without the victim's Dropbox password.

title: Update on Security at METR
note: Primary incident disclosure covering a fail-open authentication bug, API-key theft, SSH persistence and a separate campaign involving credential stuffing and OAuth token-grant attempts.

title: Authorization in MCP 2026-07-28: Clarifying trust relationships for agentic systems
note: Architecture-focused treatment of trust relationships among users, hosts, agents, MCP servers, authorization servers and downstream resources; older, but durable enough to retain as a reference.
